purpose: Avoid a third monolithic 2.28GB Git pack failure while retaining every path, byte count and SHA256.
retained: All non-binary result tables, ledgers, exclusions, manifests, plans, rejection audit and actual job logs up to 50 MiB each.
hash_only: Reproducible official-minute binary/cache payloads and any individual file over 50 MiB. Their exact path, size and SHA256 remain in COMPLETE_FILE_SHA256_MANIFEST.json; Actions artifact digests and source run are retained separately.
reconstruction: Re-download unexpired source-run artifacts or regenerate official Binance minute slices under the frozen chronology rules, then verify SHA256.
